questions.q: Statements: Some doctors are teachers. No teachers are singers. Conclusions: I. No singers are doctors. II. Some doctors are not singers.
questions.why: Checked against every possible diagram of the statements: I need not be true, II must be true. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: In a row of 40 students, A is 13th from the left and B is 9th from the right. C is 4th to the left of B. How many students are between A and C?
questions.why: B is 32nd from the left, C is 28th; between 13 and 28 are 14 students. GPSC CBRT, Jun 2025.

questions.q: Kiran's mother is the only daughter of Deepak's father. How is Deepak related to Kiran if Deepak is a man?
questions.why: Draw the family tree from the statements; the answer is Maternal uncle. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Lata's mother is the only daughter of Geeta's father. How is Geeta related to Lata if Geeta is a man?

questions.q: Ten years ago the average age of a family of 4 was 18 years. Twins were born since then, and today the average age of the family is 20 years. What is the twins' present age?
questions.why: Adults now 72 + 40 = 112; family of 6 totals 120, so twins sum 8: 4 years each. GPSC JSO pre-screening, Jun 2026.

questions.q: What is the third letter of the meaningful word formed from the 1st, 3rd, 4th, 6th, 8th and 9th letters of ASTRONAUT?
questions.why: Letters A, T, R, N, U, T make TRUANT. GPSC CBRT, Apr 2024.

questions.q: Find the wrong number in the series: 19, 27, 43, 67, 99, 137, 187
questions.why: In the correct series the differences increase by 8 each time, so 137 should be 139. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: In a non-leap year, a month contains exactly five Sundays, five Mondays and five Tuesdays. Which month could it be?
questions.why: Three days repeating five times needs a 31-day month; only August has 31 days. GPSC JSO pre-screening, Jun 2026.
